about.title: About Meadnyte
about.copy: Meadnyte is the public threshold for sound, story, image, memory, and the slow return of things that were not ready to speak until now.

house.title: The House
house.copy: The central room of Meadnyte. This is where visitors orient themselves before moving into books, music, images, signals, and future project rooms.

listen.title: Listen
listen.copy: A listening room for readings, fragments, audio medallions, SoundCloud entries, and future project-specific audio portals.

watch.title: Watch
watch.copy: A room for visual work, video releases, motion experiments, readings on screen, and future public visual portals.

signals.title: Signals
signals.copy: Public updates, launch notes, short announcements, new releases, and dispatches from inside the House.

contact.title: Contact
contact.copy: Reach the House of Meadnyte, follow the public rooms as they open, or enter through one of the social media portals below.
